_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::cardiovascular0d#1, and the execution that corrected its Signal. There is no ELASTANCE_FUNCTION parameter (ELASTANCE_FUNCTION_IS_A_PARAMETER=0; adding it fails to match CARDIOVASCULAR 0D-STRUCTURE COUPLING/SYS-PUL CIRCULATION PARAMETERS) and no T_S or T_D either (T_S_OR_T_D_IN_UPSTREAM_DECK=0). The real inputs on upstream cardiovascular0d_syspulcirculation_0d_heart are E_at_min/E_at_max and E_v_min/E_v_max per side plus four activation curves, Atrium_act_curve_l/r and Ventricle_act_curve_l/r (ACTIVATION_CURVES_IN_UPSTREAM_DECK=4), which point at FUNCT blocks carrying the systolic and diastolic timing. Collapsing every max onto its min -- constant elastance -- is accepted silently and does kill the pumping: 16 of 24 result tests wrong, p_v_l 1.04605 -> 0.83208 and mitral inflow q_vin_l -0.03333 -> +1.4856e+04. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: Result check failed with 16 errors out of 24 tests

_mutation.note: remove the constant-elastance pathology: leave the left-ventricular E_v_max at its contractile value. Fewer result tests fail, the p_v_l and q_vin_l numbers change, and the fixture must go red.
